name: Natural numbers
description: Positive integers, a(n) = n. The unit-gap base case.

name: Odd exponent-bit parity
description: Integers whose prime-factor exponents have an odd total binary popcount.

name: Nonsquares
description: Positive integers that are not perfect squares.

name: Prime numbers
description: The increasing sequence of primes. Each jump is the next prime gap.

name: Odious numbers
description: Nonnegative integers with odd binary popcount.

name: Floor of n to the 3/2
description: a(n) = floor(n^(3/2)), computed exactly as the integer square root of n³; n starts at 1.

name: Lower Wythoff sequence
description: a(n) = floor(nφ), with φ = (1 + √5)/2; evaluated using integer square roots.

name: Triangular numbers
description: Positive triangular numbers, a(n) = n(n + 1)/2. The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Square numbers
description: Positive squares, a(n) = n². The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Pentagonal numbers
description: Positive pentagonal numbers, a(n) = n(3n − 1)/2. The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Sums of three squares
description: Nonnegative integers representable as a sum of three integer squares, including 0.

name: Even exponent-bit parity
description: Positive integers whose prime-factor exponents have an even total binary popcount.

name: Squarefree composites and 1
description: 1 and the squarefree composite integers: products of at least two distinct primes.

name: Cumulative binary digit sum
description: Total binary popcount of 0 through n. Uses your site’s positive-index tail n ≥ 1; a(0) = 0 is omitted.

name: Prime powers
description: 1 and powers p^k of a prime p, with k ≥ 1.

name: At least three prime factors
description: Positive integers with at least three distinct prime divisors.

name: Sums of consecutive primes
description: a(n) = p(n) + p(n+1), the sum of consecutive primes.

name: Twin primes
description: Primes belonging to at least one twin-prime pair. Each prime is included once.

name: Semiprimes
description: Products of two primes, allowing equal primes.

name: Lesser twin primes
description: Primes p for which p + 2 is prime. Jumps go to the next lesser twin prime.
